document_host.note: Documents are NOT on the Agile API: this tenant's DMS switch is EXTERNAL, so the portal's documents tab is an iframe of a council-hosted NEC 'PublicAccess' DMS on this separate host (a naming collision - it is not Idox Public Access). PlanIt's docs_url is this link pre-built. This host was TCP-dead when last tested.

browser_route.note: <REF> is the reference URL-encoded. This is the documents link a user would follow from the portal's documents tab, and it is what PlanIt hands over as docs_url; the register itself is at the Agile portal URL. Caveat: at the last test this host was TCP-dead, so the browser route was as affected as the automated one - if it does not answer, the outage has not cleared and there is nothing to hand the user but the portal search page.

endpoints.note: Agile tenant code is PEMBROKESHIRE and happens to match the URL slug 'pembrokeshire'. The documents endpoint is the council-hosted DMS above, keyed by FOLDER1_REF=<url-encoded reference>; FileSystemId=DC is this council's planning file system.

quirks.summary: At the last test the council backend was down: every Agile data call returned 500 while the Agile health endpoint answered 200, and the DMS host was TCP-dead.
quirks.detail: This signature is an outage, NOT bot protection and NOT a portal migration - the status 'broken' is about the council's backend, not about the recipe. The mechanics are known-good on the sibling Agile tenant PCNPA. Retest before concluding anything about this authority; if the data calls answer again, the ordinary Agile route applies, subject to the external DMS below.
quirks.workaround: Retest later. Do not respond to the 500s by varying parameters or retrying in a loop.
